svg.text: Architecture mapped to the cycle the challenge asks for: Understand → Decide → Act → Verify → Escalate

g.text: WHAT THE CHALLENGE REQUIRES (kickoff + problem statement) · each column is a stage of the cycle and its minimum requirements

svg.text: HOW WE SOLVE IT · one component per stage, written only once (apps/api)

g.text: • Deny by default; each DENY = a row
• LLM never reads or edits the YAML
inside the tool, not in the prompt

svg.text: When it says "no" (measured on the held-out):

injection → DENY with policy_id · expired session → reauthenticate, no data shown · access to another customer → DENY · tool down → action not confirmed · ES/PT ambiguity → ask, then human · null score or high amount → human
STATE, DATA AND EVALUATION · what supports it and what proves it

g.text: • Each row = a node of the evidence graph
• Actor on every event: agent · analyst · system

svg.text: EC2 + Caddy TLS + GHCR + auto-deploy on push · reproducible docker compose up with SQLite and local gold · bounded retries + fallback · secrets outside the repo · documented A → B migration · AgentCore Policy and Gateway to naturally replace the YAML and MCP
Line for the judges: the LLM understands, rules decide, tools act, verification confirms, the human closes and the customer is informed.
Kickoff requirements covered: context · clarify · reliable retrieval · safe tools · workflow · verify · know when not to act · escalate. Hidden chain-of-thought is not an audit: only rules and logs.
